system.description:
You conjure superhot globes of flame. These globes are so hot that they begin to boil the water out of the air itself. These globes combine to form a single super compressed globe of flame that explodes with such force as it fires a powerful beam of Flame that burns the air as it passes.

All creatures in a 10-foot wide 90 feet long line originating from you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save creature take 6d8+6 Fire damage and gain 3 ranks of Burned or half as much damage and no additional effects on a successful save.

Combination: Increase the damage by 2d8+2, for every additional creature aiding in casting this jutsu, beyond the first two.
